source_builds.name: She Mo's On My Krill Till I Burst [Annotated]
Worlds GREATEST Mo  (PreNut Build 1) YOU MUST USE

754480263.annotation: Bigger Scorns, builds into Greater Expansion later which buffs whole kit.

1998374645.annotation: Also adds hundreds of healing to each Scorn, but only when Scorn has 2 upgrades. Your second sold item if you need slots

3399065363.annotation: Upgrade this to Enduring Speed earlier if vs certain characters with lots of slows, such as Kelvin.

3074274290.annotation: Sell if you need a slot late game, it does feel bad to lose the movespeed so I usually sell it for Enduring Speed and Juggernaut

1976391348.annotation: Use while burrowed to set up for your unburrow, or just use it while spinning. Use on tier 1 camps with Scorn to clear them instantly

395944548.annotation: Probably going to be one of your top damage source every game. I sometimes skip this if I am far behind. Get veilwalker first if you need to look for picks for the team

2603935618.annotation: Good if you just need a cheap antiheal and if no one else is buying it its good to get since they dont stack with other Healbanes.

3585132399.annotation: Still good some games while ahead, allows you to stay on map and continue pressuring. Not great when behind since you are more likely to be close to base anyways

1439347412.annotation: can buy earlier if u need the regen early

968099481.annotation: did you know by technicality, burrow has x2.25 spirit scaling?-->

7409189.annotation: but that assumes u hit your whole burrow tho, which is 80% the time, but is only like 40% with duration. (sellable if can proc tankbuster without it)

2447176615.annotation: Can buy this sooner if vs many slows (Kelvin, Viscous, etc.) Or if it helps you secure Unsecured Souls before a fight

4204808176.annotation: Pretty much a guaranteed kill if you parry bait someone, but will only work once per person at most. Beyond that, melee resist feels very good since the burrow nerf.

1813726886.annotation: Some games you just need too many Slowing Hexes, counters any hero with a movement ability.

3970837787.annotation: 15% spirit resist is super needed, +2 regen, and a good bit of extra spirit power most of the time, sameish value to spirit lifesteal

84321454.annotation: Adds hundreds of healing to each Scorn. Rush this before Monster Rounds if you are healthy enough to save. Start trying to Scorn the enemies as much as possible.

3361075077.annotation: Don't let the cost of the item bait you, this is a late game counter item to teams with many M1's. Should use while burrowed or while ulting. Having resistances makes this item better.

3270001687.annotation: This is Mo's best movement item in my opinion. You can use warp stone while burrowed to get on top of 1-story buildings and ridges. This expands Mo's getaway angles exponentially.

2922054143.annotation: ouch ouch gun ouch ouch ouch

1193964439.annotation: Good for all aspects of the hero, also increases item ranges, Torment Pulse, Warp Stone, Phantom Strike, etc. GET AN ARMOR!!!

343572757.annotation: Buy this if you are hyper carrying the game

2951612397.annotation: Cheap buy into a later Superior Duration, only buy if you know your NEXT Combo is gonna need the duration. Really techy buy.

2081037738.annotation: used instead of extra spirit as it can also proc tankbuster, teamwide damage, and gives spirit resist. Saving 6.4k and a slot without boundless

1662311306.annotation: Counter item to build versus Pocket and Wraith, but generally a good item even without a specific counter

3361811174.annotation: Cheat Death+Unstoppable+Superior Duration = Someone is getting held for a long time. Build this vs fed Shiv's now that it beats Killing Blow

865958998.annotation: VERY GOOD ITEM IF YOU GET USED TO USING IT

630839635.annotation: Imbue Burrow if they are never pulling you out, imbue sandblast if many M1s
